relationships.subject: isorhamnetin
relationships.evidence_quote: The findings indicated that ISO significantly decreased levels of NO and PGE2 while maintaining cellular integrity.

relationships.subject: isorhamnetin
relationships.evidence_quote: ISO treatment decreased mRNA levels of inducible nitric oxide synthase [iNOS] and cyclooxygenase-2 [COX-2], which were enhanced following LPS exposure.

relationships.subject: isorhamnetin
relationships.evidence_quote: the antiinflammatory properties of ISO were facilitated by the inhibition of phosphorylation in the mitogen-activated protein kinase [MAPK] family

key_findings: Isorhamnetin reduced NO, PGE2, cytokines, iNOS and COX-2 in LPS-stimulated RAW 264.7 cells via MAPK/NF-κB inhibition.
